title: Jazzsongs
style: Uplifting swinging vocal jazz with modern funk edge, warm piano, upright bass walking lines, crisp swinging drums with light funk pocket, subtle horn stabs and background vocals. Celebratory, joyful, high-energy jazz club party vibe. Male vocalist Chas delivers hype, storytelling verses with attitude and bounce. Female vocalist Jazz performs virtuosic, fun jazz scat throughout (bee boo bop, scat scat cat, doo bee doo) layered in intro, bridge and ad-libs. Theme is celebrating jazzsongs.com as the home where we lay jazz tracks all night — magic, wishes coming true, standards meeting new creations. Catchy anthemic chorus. 145 BPM, bright major key with warm soulful lifts. High production, fun, feel-good, timeless jazz with a modern sparkle.
lyrics:
[Intro – Jazz Scat + light swing]
Jazz bee boo bop… scat scat cat…
Jazzsongs dot com… we layin’ tracks…
Bee boo bop… celebrate!
[Verse 1 – Chas]
We got jazzsongs.com, yeah the site is live
Time to celebrate, keep the magic alive
Chas callin’ Jazz, bring that scat on through
Drop them jazz tracks, make the whole world move
From the old black magic to the wishes in the light
We studied the standards, now we makin’ it right
Snap back, forgot that, but the beat came back
Jazz got my feet back — now we on the attack!
[Chorus – Chas + Jazz Scat ad-libs]
Jazz songs dot com! We layin’ tracks tonight!
Jazz online, jazz on time, everything’s right
Magic in the music, wishes comin’ true
At jazzsongs dot com, it’s all for you
Bee boo bop… celebrate!
Scat scat cat… we layin’ tracks!
[Verse 2 – Chas]
Phonk in the pocket or pure swingin’ feel
Doesn’t matter the style, the jazz is real
Fast scat feet dancin’ all across the floor
Jazz got the speak, right off the beak once more
Chas in the cut, hypin’ it up loud
Jazz on the mic, makin’ the whole crowd proud
From the standards we love to the new ones we birth
Jazzsongs dot com — this is where the jazz lives on earth
[Bridge – Jazz Scat Breakdown + Chas hype]
Jazz: Doo bee doo… wah wah… jazzsongs… com…
Bee boo bop… scat scat cat…
Chas: Celebrate! Lay them tracks!
Jazz got the magic — bring it back back back!
[Final Chorus – Full band swell, bigger energy]
Jazz songs dot com! We layin’ tracks all night!
From the old black magic to the wishes in the light
Scat scat cat, panthera energy
Jazz bee boo bop at jazzsongs dot com, free!
Magic in the music, wishes comin’ true
Jazzsongs dot com… it’s all for you!
[Outro – Fading Scat + celebration]
Jazz: Bee boo bop… jazzsongs dot com…
We layin’ tracks… celebrate…
Scat scat cat… all night long…
